subtitle.text: Morning! One cold-chain parcel for the Medical Annex on Larch Street. Easy one, and your corgi can ride along as always.

say.text: …The sample. They have been waiting for this. Thanks. Don’t hang around.

ledger.text: Morning! One cold-chain parcel for the Medical Annex on Larch Street. Easy one, and your corgi can ride along as always.
Sealed and signed. Your cargo bike is at the rack out front; it is quicker to the Annex.
That bang came from the Annex, right after your delivery. …Hey, are you okay? Get off the street and grab anything you can!
